cases.name: latest_price
cases.legacy_sql:
SELECT base.mktcode, base.tgtcode, base.bizdate, code.name
FROM newzl.hsj_stock_hq_basic AS base
LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info AS code ON code.mktcode = base.mktcode AND code.tgtcode = base.tgtcode
WHERE (base.lastPx / 10000.0) > 10 AND base.bizdate = '2026-04-14'
cases.shadow_sql: SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE `q`.`lastPx` / 10000.0 > 10 AND `q`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`q_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q_latest)

cases.name: change_percent
cases.legacy_sql:
SELECT base.mktcode, base.tgtcode, base.bizdate, code.name
FROM newzl.hsj_stock_hq_basic AS base
LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info AS code ON code.mktcode = base.mktcode AND code.tgtcode = base.tgtcode
WHERE ((base.lastPx - base.preClosePx) * 100.0 / NULLIF(base.preClosePx, 0)) > 1 AND base.bizdate = '2026-04-14'
cases.shadow_sql: SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE ((`q`.`lastPx` - `q`.`preClosePx`) * 100.0) / NULLIF(`q`.`preClosePx`, 0) > 1 AND `q`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`q_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q_latest)

cases.name: main_outflow
cases.legacy_sql:
SELECT base.mktcode, base.tgtcode, base.bizdate, code.name
FROM newzl.hsj_stock_hq_basic AS base
LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info AS code ON code.mktcode = base.mktcode AND code.tgtcode = base.tgtcode
LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_hq_ext AS ext ON ext.mktcode = base.mktcode AND ext.tgtcode = base.tgtcode AND ext.bizdate = base.bizdate
WHERE (-ext.ZJLXMainNetTur) > 0 AND base.bizdate = '2026-04-14'
cases.shadow_sql: SELECT `anchor`.`mktcode`, `anchor`.`tgtcode`, `anchor`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS anchor LEFT JOIN `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_ext` AS q ON `q`.`mktcode` = `anchor`.`mktcode` AND `q`.`tgtcode` = `anchor`.`tgtcode` AND `q`.`bizdate` = `anchor`.`bizdate` WHERE -`q`.`ZJLXMainNetTur` > 0 AND `anchor`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`q_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q_latest)
